question: The value of (sin 30° cos 60° - cos 30° sin 60°) is equal to:
solution:
**Given:**

(sin 30° cos 60° - cos 30° sin 60°)

Concept used:

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/57f7fb24770768c366856a149b82fe082557fa92cb98eb20165ba2655303d87f.png] 

**Calculation:**

(sin 30° cos 60° - cos 30° sin 60°)

⇒ (1/2 × 1/2 - √3/2 × √3/2)

⇒ (1/4 - 3/4)

⇒ - 2/4

⇒ - 1/2 = -sin 30°

**∴ The required answer is -sin 30°.**
